sentences.text:
Applicant :- Krishna Gopal And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Kumar

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.

1 .  Heard Sri Chandra Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants, who are two in number and Sri V.S.
Kushwaha, learned A.G.A.
2.

In view of the order which is being proposed to be passed today, notices are not being issued to O.P. No.2.
3.

This is an application U/s 482 CrPC preferred by the applicants for quashing of the proceedings in Criminal Case No. 200 of 2017 (State Vs. Krishna Gopal and others), arising out of Case Crime No.231 of 2017, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, P.S. Karvi, District- Chitrakoot, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chitrakoot.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection and submits that let an appropriate direction be issued to the court below to verify the compromise.

6. Considering the submissions of the parties, it is hereby provided that the applicant shall appear before the court below along with the self-attested copy of the application under Section 482 CrPC,
1973 and the certified copy of the order on 28.02.2025, on which date, the court below shall undertake the process for verification and conclude the said proceeding by 25.04.2025.
7.
In view of aforesaid, the application stands disposed of.

8. Till the verification is completed, the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 200 of 2017 (State Vs.
Krishna Gopal and others), arising out of Case Crime No.231 of 2017, under Sections 420, 467, 468,
47 IPC, P.S. Karvi, District- Chitrakoot, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Chitrakoot, in so far as it relates to the applicants, shall remain stayed.
